_about: Patrick Walker (1666?-1745), the Covenanter chapman: Six Saints of the Covenant, his lives of Peden, Semple, Welwood, Cameron, Cargill and Smith, edited with illustrative documents, introduction, notes and a glossary by D. Hay Fleming, with a foreword by S. R. Crockett (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1901, 2 vols). Also Biographia Presbyteriana (Edinburgh, 1827, 2 vols), the older collected edition of his lives, whose vol. 2 adds Alexander Shields's Life of James Renwick. Volume numbers read off each title page. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
